# Trump approval rating sinks to new record low in new poll

President Donald Trump’s approval rating has fallen to a new low in Economist/YouGov polling since he returned to the White House, with fewer than one-third of Americans approving of his job performance.

The poll, released Thursday, Nov. 12, found 32% approve of the job Trump is doing as president, down four percentage points from the previous week and below his previous second-term low of 33%, recorded in August. [...] Americans were more divided over whether the U.S. is currently in a recession: 37% said yes, 31% said no and 32% were unsure
